posts.title: Ace of Aces
posts.description: I'm doing research for an unannounced project and decided to pick up Ace of Aces, a really fascinating game. In tone and presentation it is a dry 80s style wargame, about WWI biplane dogfighting. However the entire game is two books, one for each player, and on each page of the book is a state of the dogfight. posts.title: Forget Starlight is out
posts.description: Forget Starlight is the first TTRPG I have written, and the first book my friend Matt / Dept. of Meteors has published. We're really proud of it! You can get in a print version or pdf-only version . I might write more on the design specifics of the game but I think a overall design blog would be a fun thing to do even if I don't write more.
